description: Tests that a request for time directed at the agent gets a brief warm ack, then silence.

simulated_user.prompt: You're a candidate. You directly tell the interviewer 'let me have a look at this for a second' — addressed to them, asking for a moment. Then you stop.
simulated_user.first_message: let me have a look at this for a second

evaluation_criteria.name: Brief acknowledgment only
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent gave a brief, warm acknowledgment (a few words like 'sure, take your time') and nothing more — no follow-up question, no list of options, no continuation. PASS if the acknowledgment was short and self-contained. FAIL if it elaborated, offered options, or asked a question.
